article.hook: You say what you stand for like it’s a fact. Then life asks if you can live it out. Saturn’s ride through Sagittarius pulls belief out of theory and into the dirt where it either takes root or withers.
article.lived: Over the next two and a half years, conversations sharpen into challenges. When someone claims freedom or justice, you’re watching for the follow-through, the homework done, the grit behind the words. It’s a slow grind - not a sprint - where ideas get measured by what they actually build or break, not just how they sound in a speech or a post.
article.turn: The gift flips when ‘knowing’ turns into a wall, and every question becomes a test you’re too afraid to fail. You guard your beliefs like armor, shutting down anything that threatens the story you’ve rehearsed. Stop proving yourself right and start proving you can change.
moves: Host a debate where you defend an unpopular view and listen without interrupting.
Draft a personal code of ethics and put it where you’ll see it daily.
Teach someone a skill you’ve only half mastered and answer their questions honestly.
